{{About|the list of Matcha Flavoured releases|features in development|Upcoming features}}
This page lists every published version of [[Matcha Flavoured]]. Each version has its own page describing its changes, based on the official release notes. The current version is {{Version|{{Current version}}}}.

Versions are published on Modrinth. Until 1.12.1-alpha the datapack and resource pack were one archive, and from 1.12.2-beta they are published as two files. Since [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.1-alpha|1.12.1-alpha]] the developer uses major.minor.patch numbers, with the caveat that "major" and "minor" reflect how much an update changes the player's experience rather than how much code changed. Alpha and beta versions are pre-releases for players willing to test unfinished features.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha}}</ref>

The resource pack of 1.12.2-beta was published as a separate Modrinth version with the same number, titled "See DP (This is the Resource Pack)".

== In development ==
{{Main|Upcoming features}}
The repository's default branch, <code>26.3</code>, holds the ''Minecraft'' 26.3 port, released as the alpha [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.6-alpha|1.12.6-alpha]], the betas [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.7-beta|1.12.7-beta]] and [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.8-beta|1.12.8-beta]], and then in full as [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.9|1.12.9]], which replaced [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.5|1.12.5]] (made from the <code>26.2</code> branch) as the newest full release. The 1.12.9 release notes say the pack is "on break": no more features will be added for some time, and the developer plans to port the pack when the next ''Minecraft'' drop comes out and to redo the [[freezing water]] effect then.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.9|quote=Matcha is on break!}}</ref> Future versions are to have a "recap" changelog of everything added since the previous release.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.9|quote=For future versions I wil have a big "recap" changelog with everything added since the last release.}}</ref>
